thread:
Harper Lee: FYI — Pegasus Edge invoice PEG-2025-10 (USD 45,900) is 66 days overdue. Card failed on file and they asked CS to pause collections while they negotiate a credit for a support incident last month. Need approach: hold + partial payment, or proceed to standard dunning? @Jonas can you confirm the incident credit request?

Jonas Reed: Support confirmed there was one elevated incident on 2025-10-18 with degraded throughput for ~2 hours. Customer is asking for a $12k credit. Support thinks 50% credit of that request is reasonable.

Mina Desai: From Finance ops: invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: PEG-2025-10
Issued: 2025-09-20
Due: 2025-10-20
Amount: $45,900.00
Status: Past due 66 days
Auto-collect: card declined 2025-11-01
```

Caleb Ortiz: Sales flags churn risk if we cut service. Proposal: require 40% immediate payment, apply a $6,000 credit (if they sign), then split remainder into two payments at 30/30 days. No service restore until initial payment clears.

Harper Lee: I like 40/30/30 net of credit. Offer to waive late fees if they sign the settlement within 48h. If they refuse credit, proceed with collections.

billing-bot: Alert: autopay retry scheduled 2025-11-28 for PEG-2025-10.

Jonas Reed: I'll prepare a short incident summary to attach. Finance should require a signed amendment referencing the credit and payment schedule.

Mina Desai: Draft message to customer below — short and firm.

Mina Desai:
```
Subject: Payment and incident credit proposal for invoice PEG-2025-10

Hi Team,

Thanks for raising the incident. To resolve quickly and avoid service disruption we can offer a $6,000 credit toward invoice PEG-2025-10 if you agree to a short payment plan: 40% of the invoice due immediately, then 30% in 30 days and 30% in 60 days. We will waive late fees if the amendment is signed within 48 hours and the first payment is received. Service will be restored after the initial payment clears.

If you prefer not to accept this settlement, we will need to proceed with collections per contract.

Regards,
Mina Desai
Finance Ops
```

Caleb Ortiz: Sales will join the outreach. If they sign but miss installment 2, escalate to Legal/Collections.

Harper Lee: Sending at 11:10 PT. I'll post replies here and set dunning exceptions for 48h. Tracking for audit. :clipboard:

Jonas Reed: Attaching incident extract when you send will help speed acceptance.

Mina Desai: Sent. Will update thread with customer reply.
